_about: Pitch-part narration (product pitch, proof, ending), natural speed: not time-stretched. Run: python video/generated/tts.py --lines pitch_lines.json
voice_style: Say this like a founder pitching to a jury: warm, confident and clear, at a natural, slightly unhurried pace, with a short pause between sentences. Not dramatic, not robotic.

lines.text: Our platform maps the whole pathway, simulates every patient, and tests a better order before anyone waits. Same machines. Fewer days lost.
Checked against a real Norwegian hospital. In Finland: eighteen to thirty-three percent, with no new equipment.
We propose a research-based framework for future automation. Clinicians define, automate and validate each pipeline, transparently.
